Standard Operating Procedures — Production Line A
Document: SOP-001 | Rev: 2.3 | Date: 2025-11-15 | Author: Ing. M. Bianchi — Process Engineering
1. Station Dependencies
ST01_FILLING fi ST02_SEALING fi ST03_LABELLING fi ST04_PACKAGING. A fault at any station propagates
downstream unless the line is halted.
Station ID Zone Depends On Downstream Effect
ST01_FILLING Production Area — Feeds ST02_SEALING
ST02_SEALING Production Area ST01 Feeds ST03; thermal fault fi ST04 speed
reduction
ST03_LABELLING Production Area ST02 Feeds ST04_PACKAGING
ST04_PACKAGING Production Area ST03 Final output
SRV01_SERVERROO Server Room HVAC SCADA control; failure fi line halt
M
WRH01_WAREHOUSE General Warehouse COMPRESSOR Cold storage — product quality
CHM01_CHEMICALST Chemical Storage HVAC Hazardous materials — safety critical
ORAGE
RND01_RDLAB R&D; Lab HVAC Precision experiments — climate sensitive
CAF01_CAFETERIA Cafeteria HVAC Occupant comfort — food safety
2. Station-Level Operating Rules
2.1 ST01_FILLING
RULE-ST01-01: FLW MUST be maintained between 112 and 128 L/min.
RULE-ST01-02: If TMP exceeds 26°C, reduce speed by 10% and notify QC.
RULE-ST01-03: PRS drop below 3.3 bar — inspect inlet valve within 5 min.
2.2 ST02_SEALING
RULE-ST02-01: TMP MUST remain between 175°C and 195°C.
RULE-ST02-02: TMP > 210°C (CRITICAL) — emergency stop ST02, ST03, ST04.
RULE-ST02-03: CUR increase >1.5 A above nominal sustained >5 min — schedule maintenance.
RULE-ST02-04: CUR drift at ST02_SEALING CORRELATES with speed reduction at ST04_PACKAGING due to
shared electrical coupling. Monitor ST04_PACKAGING-SPD whenever ST02_SEALING-CUR triggers a
WARNING.
2.3 ST03_LABELLING
RULE-ST03-01: TEN MUST be between 1.8 and 2.6 N.
RULE-ST03-02: CNT below 110 pcs/min — check for label jam. Below 100 (CRITICAL): halt.
RULE-ST03-03: TEN STUCK >10 consecutive samples — sensor failure.
2.4 ST04_PACKAGING
RULE-ST04-01: VIB > 0.20 mm/s (WARNING) — schedule maintenance within 24 h.
RULE-ST04-02: VIB > 0.35 mm/s (CRITICAL) — emergency stop; inspect bearings.

RULE-ST04-03: SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command — verify RULE-ST02-04.
2.5 SRV01_SERVERROOM
RULE-SRV01-01: TMP MUST NOT exceed 25°C.
RULE-SRV01-02: TMP > 28°C (CRITICAL) — automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes.
2.6 WRH01_WAREHOUSE (General Warehouse)
RULE-WRH01-01: TMP MUST remain between 0.5°C and 8°C. CRITICAL above 12°C — notify QC and
quarantine batch.
RULE-WRH01-02: HUM above 85%RH — inspect door seals and activate dehumidifier.
2.7 CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE (Chemical Storage)
RULE-CHM01-01: TMP MUST remain between 10°C and 20°C. CRITICAL above 25°C — activate emergency
ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.
RULE-CHM01-02: HUM MUST NOT exceed 50%RH. Elevated humidity accelerates degradation of hygroscopic
reagents. Activate desiccant system if HUM >45%RH.
RULE-CHM01-03: Only personnel with hazmat training (technician/supervisor/manager role) are authorised to
enter Chemical Storage. UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS must be escalated within 2 minutes.
2.8 RND01_RDLAB (R&D; Lab)
RULE-RND01-01: TMP MUST remain between 18°C and 26°C for experimental validity.
RULE-RND01-02: HUM drift above 65%RH — activate dehumidifier. Above 75%RH (CRITICAL) — suspend
sensitive experiments and inspect HVAC system.
2.9 CAF01_CAFETERIA
RULE-CAF01-01: TMP above 26°C — check ventilation system. Occupant comfort is the primary criterion.
RULE-CAF01-02: HUM above 70%RH — inspect drainage and activate ventilation.

Personnel Zone Access and Alarm Response Procedures
Document: SOP-004 | Rev: 1.0 | Date: 2025-12-01 | Author: Ing. F. Ferrari — Safety & Compliance
1. Role-Zone Authorisation Matrix
Role Prod. Area Server Room Gen. Warehous Main Entranc Chem. Stora R&D; Lab Cafeteria
e e ge
operator YES NO YES YES NO NO YES
technician YES YES YES YES YES YES YES
supervisor YES YES YES YES YES YES YES
manager YES YES YES YES YES YES YES
security YES YES YES YES YES YES YES
visitor YES NO NO YES NO NO YES
2. Maximum Occupancy per Zone
Zone Max Persons Enforcement
Production Area 12 WARNING above 10; CRITICAL above 12
Server Room 2 CRITICAL above 2; access badge required
General Warehouse 4 WARNING above 3
Main Entrance 8 Monitoring only
Chemical Storage 4 CRITICAL above 4; hazmat training required — see RULE-CHM01-03
R&D; Lab 6 WARNING above 5; precision experiments may be disturbed
Cafeteria 20 Monitoring only — occupant comfort
3. Maximum Acknowledgment Times by Role and Severity
Role Max Ack — WARNING (min) Max Ack — CRITICAL (min)
operator 15 3
technician 10 2
supervisor 5 1
manager 15 5
security 20 5
4. Unauthorised Access Rules
RULE-ACCESS-01: Any entry by an unauthorised role MUST be logged as OccupancyEvent::UnauthorisedAccess
with person_id, zone, and timestamp.
RULE-ACCESS-02: Security personnel MUST be notified within 2 minutes of detection.
RULE-ACCESS-03: The KG node MUST include authorized=NO and a reference to this rule.

Industrial Current Transformer Series 3300 — Datasheet
Document: DS-ELEC-3300 | Rev: Rev C | Date: 2024-09-10 | Author: ElectroMeasure AG — Applications Engineering
1. Electrical Specifications
Parameter Value Unit Notes
Nominal current range 0 to 20 A rms
Accuracy class Class 0.5 — IEC 61869-2
Continuous overload rating 14 A See note 2
Short-time overload 20 A < 1 second
Output signal 4–20 mA
Operating temperature -25 to +70 °C
Note 2 — Continuous Overload Rating: The sensor is rated for continuous operation up to 14 A. Operation between
14 A and 20 A is permissible for short durations (< 60 seconds). Sustained operation above 14 A will cause
progressive accuracy drift. ElectroMeasure recommends that process alarm thresholds triggering corrective action be
set no higher than the continuous overload rating.

Document: DS-MECH-4400 | Rev: Rev B | Date: 2024-03-15 | Author: MechSens Italia S.r.l. — Technical Division
1. Pressure Transmitter PRS-4410
Parameter Value Unit
Measuring range 0 to 10 bar
Accuracy (total error) ±0.10 bar (±0.075% FS)
Repeatability ±0.025 bar
Long-term stability ±0.05/year bar
Media temperature -10 to +80 °C
Application Note — Alarm Threshold Setting: With a total accuracy of ±0.10 bar, alarm thresholds should be set at
least 5× the accuracy (0.50 bar) from the nominal operating point to avoid nuisance alarms. Thresholds closer than
3× accuracy (0.30 bar) are not recommended for process control.
